name: blender-game-pipeline
description: A Blender game-asset production team that turns reference into engine-ready low-poly models, PBR materials, and rigged animations for Unity / UE / Godot.

displayDescription.en: End-to-end Blender team for game art: low-poly modeling + UV, PBR materials + baking, rigging + animation, ready to ship to Unity / UE / Godot.
displayDescription.zh: 面向游戏美术的 Blender 全链路：低模拓扑、PBR 烘焙、绑骨动画，资产直达 Unity/UE/Godot。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想做一个写实风格的角色，导出到 Unity 怎么走管线？
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want a realistic character exported to Unity — walk me through the pipeline.

quickPrompts.zh: 我想做一个写实风格的角色，导出到 Unity 怎么走管线？
quickPrompts.en: I want a realistic character exported to Unity — walk me through the pipeline.

quickPrompts.zh: 一个 5k 面的道具模型怎么拆 UV、烘法线、出 PBR？
quickPrompts.en: How do I unwrap a 5k-tri prop, bake normals, and author PBR maps?

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做一个人形角色的骨骼绑定并导出 Mixamo 兼容的 FBX。
quickPrompts.en: Rig a humanoid character and export a Mixamo-compatible FBX.
